items.title: Joseph "Red" Clark Interview, 1959-11-11
items.q: Percy was telling me about how Buddy Petit and his brother Earl Humphrey would go around and give a sample

ctx.x: Well, you tell me something about, you mentioned Dick did something about a sample. Did you all ever give samples of how did that work?

Percy was telling me about how Buddy Petit and his brother Earl Humphrey would go around and give a sample for the wood at the quake. Have you ever heard of that? No. Well, that sounds like Buddy Petit. No, that's a joke. Percy was just joking. That's a joke. We got to see him and ask him about it.
